body: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. Interactive-SDPO then conditions a weight-sharing self-teacher on the replay trace and a 2x2 state-transition montage to provide token-level supervision at zero inference-time overhead. On the public Vision2Web L2, one-shot InteractiveCoder-9B nearly 3x its base model's functional score (20.2 to 55.2 FS) and matches a 1T-parameter coding agent in a single pass with 111x fewer total parameters and 78x fewer tokens. On our WebVibeBench, InteractiveCoder-4B and 9B further outperform all evaluated baselines by over 23 points.
summaryZh: WebVibe：通过逆向合成和视觉自蒸馏生成多模态交互式网站。尽管多模态大语言模型将单个屏幕截图翻译为静态 HTML，但根据设计规范生成交互式功能网站仍然难以应对多页面路由和有状态小部件转换。检查现有的训练流程揭示了两个瓶颈：（1）在前向数据合成（X -> Y）中，在代码执行之前编写规范 X，从而将 X 中未实现或更改的需求作为监督噪声； （2）在强化学习中，标量奖励丢弃了重放期间观察到的丰富的状态转换。
